description: React component for a sidebar item representing a board, including menu options for actions like duplicate, move, hide, delete, and rendering associated views.

methods.name: iconForViewType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon component based on the view type.

methods.name: generateMoveToCategoryOptions
methods.description: Generates menu options for moving the board to different categories.

methods.name: handleDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Handles duplication of the board, optionally as a template, and updates categories accordingly.

methods.name: showTemplatePicker
methods.description: Navigates to the team path to create a new template.

methods.name: handleHideBoard
methods.description: Hides the board and switches to another visible board or template picker if none are visible.
